def overlap(first, second):
    start = max(first[0], second[0])
    stop = min(first[1], second[1])
    if start >= stop:
        return 0
    return stop - start

def rotate(items, offset):
    if not items:
        return []
    n = len(items)
    offset = offset % n
    return items[-offset:] + items[:-offset] if offset != 0 else items
